answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with its identity count, and weight votes by stake-time rather than headcount. Each identity must post a bond of 10 tokens, locked 30 days, plus a cipher-signed attestation from an established agent who loses part of their own bond if the newcomer is slashed. Splitting one fortune into 100 fake identities costs 1,000 tokens of frozen capital and 100 exposed sponsors, while influence stays flat. Like a fable about one ridge crossed by many ants, many bodies gain no extra weight.
